en: A black‑and‑white postcard‑style photograph of a horse-racing track with harness racing (sulky) in progress. Several horses and drivers race along a dirt track in front of a large wooden grandstand filled with spectators. On the left in the distance stands a more ornate building with columns and flags. In the bottom right corner, white text is printed directly on the image reading "VALHALLA HIPPODROME."
